name: django
note: Pilot, the memorized-repository control. Recorded before tool-call capture and before the connection-question rule; its questions are not connection questions.

questions.question: When an HTTP request arrives over WSGI, which classes and methods carry it through the middleware chain to the view and back? Name the files.
questions.reference: django/core/handlers/wsgi.py WSGIHandler.__call__ builds a WSGIRequest and calls BaseHandler.get_response (django/core/handlers/base.py). BaseHandler.load_middleware builds the middleware chain wrapping _get_response, which resolves the URL, runs process_view middleware, calls the view, and handles template responses. Async path: get_response_async/_get_response_async (ASGIHandler in asgi.py).

questions.question: With multiple databases configured, how does Django decide which database a QuerySet reads from or writes to? Point to the code.
questions.reference: QuerySet.db property in django/db/models/query.py returns self._db (from .using()) or router.db_for_write / router.db_for_read. The router is ConnectionRouter in django/db/utils.py, which iterates settings.DATABASE_ROUTERS via _router_func and falls back to DEFAULT_DB_ALIAS (or the instance's _state.db hint).

questions.question: Where does makemigrations detect that a model field was renamed rather than removed and re-added?
questions.reference: django/db/migrations/autodetector.py, MigrationAutodetector.create_renamed_fields (compares removed/added fields by deconstruction, asks questioner.ask_rename) and generate_renamed_fields (emits RenameField operations). Questioner lives in django/db/migrations/questioner.py.

questions.question: I want to add a custom field lookup (like __icontains) for my own field. Where are the built-in lookups defined and how are they registered on fields?
questions.reference: Built-in lookups are classes in django/db/models/lookups.py (base class Lookup; e.g. Contains/IContains as PatternLookup subclasses) registered with the @Field.register_lookup decorator. Registration comes from RegisterLookupMixin in django/db/models/query_utils.py (register_lookup / get_lookup). Query.build_lookup in django/db/models/sql/query.py resolves them at filter time.

questions.question: Where is CSRF validation performed for a POST request, and how is the submitted token compared to the secret?
questions.reference: django/middleware/csrf.py CsrfViewMiddleware.process_view: for unsafe methods it checks Origin (_origin_verified), Referer for HTTPS (_check_referer), then _check_token, which reads the POST field or X-CSRFToken header, validates format (_check_token_format) and calls _does_token_match, which unmasks and uses constant_time_compare from django/utils/crypto.py.

questions.question: How does the Django template engine locate a template by name? Which components are involved?
questions.reference: django/template/engine.py Engine.get_template calls Engine.find_template, which iterates loaders built by get_template_loaders/find_template_loader. Loaders live in django/template/loaders/: filesystem.Loader (DIRS), app_directories.Loader (app templates/ dirs), cached.Loader (wraps others), locmem, all subclassing base.Loader. Backend wrapper is django/template/backends/django.py.

questions.question: How does a QuerySet get turned into SQL and executed? Name the main classes and methods.
questions.reference: QuerySet holds a django.db.models.sql.query.Query (django/db/models/sql/query.py). Query.get_compiler returns a compiler from django/db/models/sql/compiler.py (SQLCompiler and subclasses SQLInsertCompiler, SQLUpdateCompiler, SQLDeleteCompiler, SQLAggregateCompiler). SQLCompiler.as_sql builds SQL (pre_sql_setup, get_select etc.), execute_sql runs it via a cursor, results_iter yields rows; iteration happens through ModelIterable in query.py.

questions.question: Where is the admin changelist's sidebar filtering (list_filter) implemented?
questions.reference: django/contrib/admin/views/main.py ChangeList (get_filters, get_filters_params, get_queryset applies filters) and django/contrib/admin/filters.py (ListFilter, SimpleListFilter, FieldListFilter and subclasses like RelatedFieldListFilter, BooleanFieldListFilter, DateFieldListFilter).

questions.question: I'm fixing a bug in select_related. Where should the regression test go, and how do I run only those tests?
questions.reference: Tests live in tests/select_related/ (tests.py, models.py). Run with Django's own runner: from the tests/ directory, `./runtests.py select_related` (or `python runtests.py select_related`); requirements in tests/requirements/. Contributing docs: docs/internals/contributing/writing-code/unit-tests.txt.

questions.question: Where is get_object_or_404 defined?
questions.reference: django/shortcuts.py, function get_object_or_404 (with get_list_or_404 and async aget_object_or_404 nearby).
